best_match.fbbt_definition: Renamed from lPN as this now implies dorsal hemilineage (Bates et al., 2020). Antennal lobe projection neuron that derives from the lateral antennal lobe neuroblast.

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (lPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: lPN 102.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067362 antennal lobe projection neuron of ALl1 lineage (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for DA1_fru-.
